summary: Indonesia Energy Corp Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release about an operational milestone: discovery of good quality oil during testing at the newly drilled K-29 well in the Kruh Block. The well reached total depth of 3,378 feet, with production expected to commence within weeks. The filing also announces an upcoming YouTube Live presentation by President Frank Ingriselli. No transaction, tender offer, spin-off, restructuring, or other special-situation event is involved. This is a routine operational update by a foreign private issuer; no deal terms or structural changes to analyze.
